purpose: Machine-readable reconciliation map for the en-es semantic sentence-veto runtime, research harnesses, candidate artifacts, and follow-up audit passes.

state_definitions.current_runtime: Participates in the browser/helper YES/NO decision path today.
state_definitions.current_reference: Maintained reference or process doc for current work.
state_definitions.current_research: Active research harness or ledger used to evaluate candidates.
state_definitions.current_candidate: Part of the single current research candidate stack, not runtime-promoted.
state_definitions.supporting_current: Supports the current candidate or current interpretation but is not itself the candidate.
state_definitions.generated_evidence: Generated or rendered artifact used as evidence, not authority by itself.
state_definitions.diagnostic_only: Useful for investigation or negative controls, not promotion authority.
state_definitions.historical_reference: Still useful context but not current steering truth.
state_definitions.queued_audit: Known important surface that must be classified in a later pass.
state_definitions.superseded: Preserved for audit history but replaced by a newer lane.

component_definitions.source_admission: Evidence generation, normalization, leakage checks, source merge, and sense admission.
component_definitions.candidate_wave6: Current wave6 auth-frame plus raw-sentence plus rescue replay candidate.
component_definitions.evaluation_data: Frozen datasets, heldout cases, phrase/no-winner cases, and queues.
component_definitions.diagnostics: Failure mining, summary renderers, and crack-finding tools.
component_definitions.process_governance: Docs and ledgers that coordinate many-turn work.
component_definitions.historical_or_seed: Seed-pass lanes and older artifacts that should not silently steer current promotion.

pass_checklist.lens: Trace the actual production YES/NO path and label nearby non-runtime tools.
primary_outputs: registry entries with current_runtime or current_research state
cracks_to_watch: research policy mistaken for runtime default
named policy docs drifting from code
fallback behavior obscuring semantic abstain behavior

pass_checklist.lens: Map each active harness to the exact question it answers.
primary_outputs: harness rows grouped by decision axis
duplicate or superseded harness rows labeled explicitly
cracks_to_watch: one harness using a different input lane than its name implies
final decision-rule and active-score experiments being mixed
negative controls omitted from candidate claims

pass_checklist.lens: Separate frozen inputs, generated source rows, latest reports, and historical outputs.
cracks_to_watch: latest artifact pointing at stale source input
discovery rows blended into locked eval
missing input hashes or unclear dataset ids

pass_checklist.lens: Turn hidden candidate assumptions into explicit evidence-linked rows.
primary_outputs: assumption ledger entries for context, evidence, scorer, guard, and thresholds
cracks_to_watch: raw_sentence treated as universally better
rescue gates treated as safe outside tested phrase suites
source class frames growing without source-backed triggers

pass_checklist.lens: Search specifically for test-shaped behavior and leakage.
cracks_to_watch: browser sentence text inside evidence rows
Spanish target lemma leakage
threshold selected on the same heldout suite used for promotion
templates shaped to one case instead of source class

pass_checklist.lens: Reduce the project to one current candidate, one control, one blocker list, and one next breadth test.
cracks_to_watch: multiple candidates described as current
phrase/no-winner behavior hidden inside active/shadow metrics
promotion criteria moving after results are known

pass_checklist.lens: Demote or label old artifacts after surviving value is migrated.
cracks_to_watch: deleting artifacts before preserving their lesson
old latest artifacts retaining steering power
docs citing generated outputs as authority

promotion_blockers: bounded to 16 families and 54 heldout cases
scorer-backed confirmation is still offline and not a runtime policy change
wave7_source_class_breadth_v1 executed and failed with harmful replacements plus false abstains

entries.title: Runtime semantic scoring implementation
entries.role: Computes context views, evidence similarities, active-vs-shadow margins, phrase preemption, and rescue behavior for runtime decisioning.
entries.current_use: Production code path when semantic admission is active.
entries.risk: Runtime behavior can drift from research lanes if policy ids or context/evidence views are confused.

entries.title: Runtime semantic policy registry
entries.role: Defines named production semantic decision policies and pair defaults.
entries.current_use: Production policy resolution; not automatically changed by research artifacts.
entries.risk: Research candidates can be mistaken for pair defaults.

entries.title: Extension manifest runtime order
entries.role: Declares nativeMessaging permission, background service worker, and content-script load order for helper transport, semantic runtime modules, diagnostics, settings, and content bootstrap.
entries.current_use: Ensures semantic runtime modules and the native-message bridge are available before content_script.js boots.
entries.risk: Script-order drift can make the semantic gate unavailable or force browser matches down fallback paths before policy scoring.

entries.title: Extension content-script runtime bootstrap
entries.role: Constructs the helper client, helper rules runtime, active-rules runtime, semantic gate runtime, DOM scan runtime, settings pipeline, and runtime action loop.
entries.current_use: Top-level browser runtime wiring that connects semantic readiness, per-text admission, and DOM replacement rendering.
entries.risk: Bootstrap wiring drift can disconnect tested runtime modules or bypass semantic admission entirely.

entries.title: Extension apply-settings semantic propagation
entries.role: Runs active-rules resolution, writes semantic admission capability and fallback policy into current settings, and invokes runtime apply actions.
entries.current_use: Settings propagation surface that determines whether the semantic gate sees srsSemanticAdmissionEnabled and the selected fallback policy.
entries.risk: A propagation mismatch can make ready semantic coverage look inactive, or can apply the wrong fallback policy in the browser gate.

entries.title: Extension active-rules semantic readiness gate
entries.role: Resolves active SRS-origin rules, checks ready semantic-admission coverage, resolves semantic inventory availability, and exposes whether semantic admission is active for the scan runtime.
entries.current_use: Browser-side readiness gate before any semantic YES/NO batch is attempted.
entries.risk: A ready-rule or inventory availability mismatch can make semantic gating silently fall back before policy scoring runs.

entries.title: Extension semantic gate runtime
entries.role: Builds semantic-admission request batches from browser matches, applies fallback/debug decisions, and filters retained matches to effective replace decisions.
entries.current_use: Browser-visible YES/NO gate between lexical match selection and replacement rendering.
entries.risk: Fallback defaults, inventory errors, or debug overrides can be mistaken for policy decisions if the decision_source is ignored.

entries.title: Extension replacement renderer
entries.role: Calls the semantic gate after lexical match filtering and renders only retained replacement spans into the DOM.
entries.current_use: Final browser-side point where an abstained semantic match stays as source text and a replace decision becomes visible DOM.
entries.risk: The DOM outcome can be misread if filtered-out matches are not distinguished from no lexical match.

entries.title: Extension helper rules runtime
entries.role: Fetches helper rules, helper or cached semantic inventory, and helper semantic-admission batch responses for the content runtime.
entries.current_use: Browser-to-helper bridge used by active-rules readiness and semantic batch admission.
entries.risk: Helper transport errors and helper-cache fallbacks can change whether browser matches reach policy scoring.

entries.title: Extension helper semantic inventory cache
entries.role: Persists and reloads helper semantic inventory by pair/profile for helper-cache readiness fallback.
entries.current_use: Cached inventory surface that can keep semantic scoring available when the helper inventory request falls back to helper-cache.
entries.risk: Stale or profile-mismatched cached inventory can make semantic admission appear available with outdated evidence.

entries.title: Extension helper transport bridge
entries.role: Sends content-runtime helper requests through chrome.runtime messaging to the background native-message bridge.
entries.current_use: Content-to-background transport layer for get_semantic_inventory and semantic_admit_batch requests.
entries.risk: Bridge timeouts or unavailable runtime messaging surface as helper errors and semantic fallback decisions.

entries.title: Extension helper client
entries.role: Sends native-helper messages for semantic inventory lookup and semantic_admit_batch requests.
entries.current_use: Shared transport client beneath the browser semantic inventory and admission calls.
entries.risk: Transport-level failures surface as fallback decisions rather than semantic policy outcomes.

entries.title: Extension background native-message bridge
entries.role: Receives helper bridge requests from content scripts and forwards them to the native helper host.
entries.current_use: Background service-worker bridge between extension runtime messaging and native helper requests.
entries.risk: Native host unavailability, timeout, or permission failures become helper errors that trigger semantic fallback instead of policy scoring.

entries.title: Native helper semantic dispatch
entries.role: Routes extension native messages for get_semantic_inventory and semantic_admit_batch into helper engine use cases.
entries.current_use: Native-message dispatch point between the extension transport and Python helper runtime.
entries.risk: A dispatch mismatch can make browser-side semantic readiness look available while admission requests fail.

entries.title: Helper semantic admission use case
entries.role: Validates semantic-admission request batches, loads the profile semantic inventory, and delegates response construction to the runtime policy layer.
entries.current_use: Python helper entrypoint for browser semantic_admit_batch requests.
entries.risk: Inventory profile or pair mismatches here force fallback decisions before scoring.

entries.title: Helper engine semantic entrypoint
entries.role: Exposes load_semantic_inventory and semantic_admit_batch through the helper engine API.
entries.current_use: Runtime helper API surface reached by the native host and helper CLI layers.
entries.risk: Engine-level routing drift can disconnect tested use cases from the native-helper surface.

entries.title: Semantic runtime diagnostics surfaces
entries.role: Reports semantic inventory, semantic-admission pointer, and publication-manifest health for operators.
entries.current_use: Diagnostic evidence only; it does not decide browser replace or abstain outcomes.
entries.risk: Diagnostic pass/fail wording can be mistaken for the actual semantic gate decision path.

entries.title: Semantic sentence-veto algorithm reference
entries.role: Human reference for the end-to-end algorithm and runtime/research separation.
entries.current_use: Primary algorithm map before runtime-path audits.
entries.risk: Can become stale if code defaults change without doc update.

entries.title: Semantic source admission program
entries.role: Planning and operating model for source coverage, leakage checks, sense admission, and promotion gating.
entries.current_use: Source-admission history, operating constraints, and older source-lane lessons; current candidate authority lives in the reconciliation registry.
entries.risk: Older current-best and promotion-candidate language can obscure the current wave6 auth-frame candidate unless routed through the archive ledger.

entries.title: Semantic decision rule comparison plan
entries.role: Separates final YES/NO rules from context, evidence, scorer, aggregation, and phrase experiments.
entries.current_use: Methodology guardrail before changing decision rules, now including the wave6 source/guard finding as research-only context; not current candidate evidence by itself.
entries.risk: Decision-rule methodology can be misread as source-admission proof, runtime policy, or a current candidate claim if not routed through the registry and generated evidence.

entries.title: Semantic decision research lanes ledger
entries.role: Tracks research lane states without collapsing them into a generic complete state.
entries.current_use: Research-lane state ledger for decision experiments, including semantic-class-frame adapters as active source-program work; current system truth is summarized by the reconciliation registry.
entries.risk: Can preserve older lane language that looks current unless paired with the system registry and archive ledger.

entries.title: Semantic decision research lanes rendered summary
entries.role: Human-readable rendering and audit result for the semantic decision research lanes ledger.
entries.current_use: Confirms lane counts, state counts, and no methodology issues after ledger changes; not runtime authority.
entries.risk: Generated latest summary can be mistaken for promotion evidence unless paired with the source ledger and registry state.

entries.title: Decision rule matrix harness
entries.role: Answers final decision-research questions by comparing context representation, evidence scope, scorer, aggregation, final rule, phrase handling, and negative-control families from explicit manifests.
entries.current_use: Final-rule and representation matrix; not source admission and not runtime policy.
entries.risk: Multiple axes can be confused if result rows are summarized too aggressively.

entries.title: Source admission cycle harness
entries.role: Answers whether a candidate evidence batch survives leakage checks, duplicate filtering, merge, final-composite sense admission, source contract reporting, and optional seed ablation.
entries.current_use: Canonical admission wrapper for source rows before held-out validation.
entries.risk: Skipping heldout validation can make analysis-only admission look stronger than it is.

entries.title: Semantic source heldout validation harness
entries.role: Answers whether one configured evidence batch and decision shape survives a locked held-out suite, including active/shadow and phrase/no-winner suites when run separately.
entries.current_use: Active/shadow and phrase/no-winner candidate validation.
entries.risk: A clean active/shadow suite can hide phrase/no-winner harm if not paired with phrase validation.

entries.title: Semantic source margin policy sweep
entries.role: Answers whether scalar active/shadow margin and phrase-prototype margin settings pass the current held-out suites for a fixed evidence batch and decision shape.
entries.current_use: Score-surface and threshold research; not source admission and not runtime policy.
entries.risk: Policy grids can be overread as promotion if not validated on locked heldout suites.

entries.title: Prototype admission probe harness
entries.role: Answers whether prototype evidence plus phrase containment, phrase prototypes, and surface-POS guard variants improve binary admission on a selected queue or all dataset families.
entries.current_use: Mechanism probe for prototype evidence and guard shapes before broader matrix or admission-cycle interpretation.
entries.risk: Prototype guard wins can be overread if the evaluation scope is prompt-queue sized or if source provenance is not separated.

entries.title: Prototype ablation matrix harness
entries.role: Answers which source mode, scorer, context view, threshold, and guard shape created a prototype-lane gain or regression.
entries.current_use: No-spend ablation matrix for source/scorer/context/guard separation.
entries.risk: A good ablation row is not an admitted source batch and can hide leakage or held-out failures.

entries.title: Semantic source failure-class mining harness
entries.role: Answers which reusable failure classes, breadth gaps, overfit risks, and tracked residuals remain after reading admission, held-out, source, and margin-sweep artifacts.
entries.current_use: Anti-handcrafting diagnostic before interpreting a clean seed or wave result as promotion evidence.
entries.risk: Failure-class mining summarizes evidence; it does not independently validate a candidate or change promotion state.

entries.title: Semantic source row alignment audit harness
entries.role: Answers whether admitted source rows carry trigger-adjacent and selector-ready context needed for context-conditioned or additive source evidence experiments.
entries.current_use: Source-row quality audit before frame-gap planning and context-conditioned evidence tests.
entries.risk: Selector-ready row counts can be mistaken for downstream decision quality if not paired with admission and held-out validation.

entries.title: Semantic source frame-gap planning harness
entries.role: Answers which active or shadow source-frame slots remain under-covered after row-alignment audits and how generation should be queued.
entries.current_use: Generation-planning surface; not generated evidence and not admission by itself.
entries.risk: A frame-gap plan can be mistaken for accepted evidence if the later generation, leakage, sense admission, and held-out checks are skipped.

entries.title: Phrase policy signal audit harness
entries.role: Answers whether phrase-control signal extraction fires on fresh no-winner cases without source evidence or semantic scoring.
entries.current_use: Signal-only phrase/no-winner audit before promoting phrase cases into end-to-end held-out suites.
entries.risk: Signal-only pass results do not validate translation targets, source evidence, or final replace/abstain decisions.

entries.title: Non-v10 wave admission sweep harness
entries.role: Answers whether automatic non-v10 family construction plus local source extraction can produce semantic-complete candidate waves before held-out validation.
entries.current_use: Breadth and source-support discovery surface for non-v10 waves.
entries.risk: Admission-selected waves are discovery artifacts until source support conversion, held-out validation, phrase validation, and failure mining pass.

entries.title: Surface-POS rescue replay sweep
entries.role: Answers whether deterministic surface-POS rescue gates can replay a fixed active/shadow plus phrase/no-winner score surface without adding harmful replacements.
entries.current_use: Current wave6 combined-suite rescue candidate exploration.
entries.risk: Replay-only candidate can be mistaken for runtime policy.

entries.title: Surface-POS rescue policy validation harness
entries.role: Answers whether the recommended rescue gates still pass after recomputing active/shadow and phrase/no-winner scorer rows from the evidence batch.
entries.current_use: Offline scorer-backed confirmation for the current wave6 rescue policy candidate.
entries.risk: Still offline validation; it does not implement or package a runtime policy.

entries.title: Authorization-frame evidence adapter
entries.role: Answers whether source-backed permission-like senses can receive deterministic authorization-frame evidence rows without using browser-case text.
entries.current_use: Current source-backed semantic-class repair for permission-like senses.
entries.risk: Template expansion could become case-shaped if not source-triggered and heldout-checked.

entries.title: Wiktextract translation-sense evidence adapter
entries.role: Answers whether already-supported translation-table English sense text can be converted into normalized source evidence rows.
entries.current_use: Wave6 selected-sense source coverage foundation.
entries.risk: Translation-sense text must stay source-backed and not target-lemma-derived.

entries.title: WordNet alternate-sense phrase evidence adapter
entries.role: Answers whether WordNet alternate-sense rows can provide phrase/no-winner containment evidence while staying distinct from broad active/shadow semantic competition.
entries.current_use: Wave6 phrase/no-winner coverage foundation.
entries.risk: Phrase rows must not become broad semantic competitors without a dedicated ablation.

entries.title: Wave6 translation-sense source-admission report
entries.role: Records the admitted translation-sense plus WordNet base composite used before alternate-sense phrase extraction.
entries.current_use: Intermediate current-lane composite; required before alternate-sense phrase adapter output can be reproduced from a fresh checkout.
entries.risk: Semantic active/shadow contract is complete, but phrase contract remains review until alternate-sense phrase rows are added.

entries.title: Wave6 alternate-sense phrase source-admission report
entries.role: Records the admitted alternate-sense phrase composite used as the raw-sentence control and auth-frame base.
entries.current_use: Intermediate current-lane control composite; auth-frame admission layers deterministic authorization rows on top of it.
entries.risk: Leakage audit remains review because some alternate-sense phrase rows are filtered; do not treat raw adapter output as the admitted composite.

entries.title: Wave6 Wiktextract-supported source dataset
entries.role: Base selected-family dataset for the current wave6 source-backed candidate.
entries.current_use: Current candidate source input.
entries.risk: Lives under test_outputs/experiments, so registry must keep its role explicit.

entries.title: Wave6 active/shadow heldout cases
entries.role: Locked active/shadow validation cases for the current wave6 candidate.
entries.current_use: Current active/shadow heldout suite.
entries.risk: Thresholds chosen on this suite would not be independent promotion evidence.

entries.title: Wave6 phrase/no-winner heldout cases
